metadata.title: 2022 Philippine senatorial election results
metadata.primarySource: Commission on Elections 2022 National and Local Elections Results
metadata.transportSource: OpenHalalan v4+ corrected COMELEC JSON API scrape
metadata.rankingMethod: Standard competition ranking by votes within each geography; ties share a rank.
metadata.percentageNote: Municipality percentages are retained from the COMELEC-derived transport dataset. Aggregate percentages divide candidate votes by votes obtained by all Senate candidates.
metadata.aggregationMethod: Province, region, and the complete-candidate national working record are derived by summing geographic city/municipality records. The separate officialNationalTop12 field reproduces the NBOC's 172-of-173 COC proclamation totals, which already include overseas votes.
metadata.ballotNumberNote: COMELEC's official ballot lists the 64 Senate candidates alphabetically from 1 (Afuang) through 64 (Zubiri); the extracted directory exactly follows that order.
